# RELO: YouTube Bridge

> Cross-device YouTube remote control bridging a phone web/Android app (`apps/web`), a Chrome Manifest V3 extension (`apps/extension`), and a Node.js HTTP/WebSocket relay (`services/api`).

## Repository Structure
- `services/api`: Node.js 22+ HTTP + WebSocket relay server on port `8787`.
- `apps/extension`: Chrome Manifest V3 extension receiver (`apps/extension/dist` after build).
- `apps/web`: React 19 + Vite + TypeScript phone UI on port `5173`, with Capacitor Android project in `apps/web/android`.
- `RELO_Design_System`: Brand logos, guidelines, and UI design reference.

## Automated Local Setup Steps
1. Clone the repository:
   `git clone https://github.com/LeonBijo/Relo.git && cd Relo`
2. Relay API (`services/api`):
   - `cd services/api && cp .env.example .env && npm install`
   - Optional: ask the user for a `YOUTUBE_API_KEY` to enable YouTube search.
   - Start with `npm start` (runs on `http://localhost:8787`).
3. Chrome Extension (`apps/extension`):
   - `cd apps/extension && npm install && npm run build`
   - Instruct the user to open `chrome://extensions`, enable Developer mode, and load unpacked `apps/extension/dist`.
4. Phone Web App (`apps/web`):
   - `cd apps/web && npm install && npm run dev` (runs on `http://0.0.0.0:5173`).
5. Optional Android Debug APK (`apps/web/android`):
   - `cd apps/web && npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug`
   - Output: `apps/web/android/app/build/outputs/apk/debug/RELO-debug.apk`

## Verification Commands
- `cd services/api && npm run typecheck && npm test`
- `cd apps/extension && npm run typecheck && npm test`
- `cd apps/web && npm run typecheck && npm run build`
